AddAccountRelation.description_zh: 创建一个财务关联关系

AllocateCostUnitResource.description_en: Transfers resource instances from the source cost center to the destination cost center
AllocateCostUnitResource.description_zh: 资源实例（实例型和分拆型）从源财务单元分配到目标财务单元

CancelOrder.description_zh: 调用CancelOrder取消未支付订单服务

ConfirmRelation.description_en: Confirms an invitation from an Alibaba Cloud account
ConfirmRelation.description_zh: 子账号确认主账号发起的邀约

ConvertChargeType.description_en: Changes the subscription type for an instance. Currently, this operation supports converting pay-as-you-go instances of SLB, EIP, and NAT Gateway to subscription instances, and converting subscription instances of SLB and EIP to pay-as-you-go instances
ConvertChargeType.description_zh: 为一个实例变更订阅类型。目前支持SLB、EIP和NAT网关后付费实例转预付费实例，和SLB、EIP产品预付费转后付费实例操作

CreateAgAccount.description_zh: 创建一个财务关联关系

CreateCostUnit.description_en: Creates one or more cost centers
CreateCostUnit.description_zh: 创建财务单元，支持批量创建

CreateInstance.description_en: Creates an instance resource. This operation creates an order for a new instance resource and completes automatic payment. ECS and RDS product series are not supported
CreateInstance.description_zh: 创建一个实例资源，会创建一个新购实例资源的订单，并自动支付。不支持ECS和RDS系列产品的创建

CreateResellerUserQuota.description_en: Creates a user quota ledger and a quota consumption ledger
CreateResellerUserQuota.description_zh: 创建用户 Quota 配额账本和 Quota 消费账本

DescribeCostBudgetsSummary.description_en: Queries a summary of cost budgets
DescribeCostBudgetsSummary.description_zh: 查询用户 “成本管理-预算”的概要信息

DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByAmortizat.description_en: Queries the monthly amortized costs of instances for a specified amortization month
DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByAmortizat.description_zh: 以摊销月视角查询月实例摊销成本

DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByConsumePe.description_en: Queries the monthly amortized cost of an instance by billing cycle
DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByConsumePe.description_zh: 以账期月视角查询月实例摊销成本

DescribeInstanceBill.description_en: Queries the consumption summary of all product instances or billable items for an account within a billing cycle
DescribeInstanceBill.description_zh: 查询用户某个账期内所有商品实例或计费项的消费汇总

DescribePricingModule.description_en: Queries the module information of a specified Alibaba Cloud product
DescribePricingModule.description_zh: 查询阿里云某个产品对应模块信息

DescribeProductAmortizedCostByAmortizati.description_en: Queries the monthly amortized cost of products for a specified month
DescribeProductAmortizedCostByAmortizati.description_zh: 以摊销月视角查询月产品摊销成本

DescribeProductAmortizedCostByConsumePer.description_en: Queries the monthly amortized cost of a product for a specific billing cycle
DescribeProductAmortizedCostByConsumePer.description_zh: 以账期月视角查询月产品摊销成本

DescribeResourceCoverageDetail.description_en: Queries the coverage details of reserved instances (RIs) or storage capacity units (SCUs)
DescribeResourceCoverageDetail.description_zh: 预留实例、SCU覆盖率明细查询

DescribeResourceCoverageTotal.description_en: Queries the total coverage data of reserved instances (RIs) or storage capacity units (SCUs)
DescribeResourceCoverageTotal.description_zh: 预留实例、SCU覆盖率汇总查询

DescribeResourcePackageProduct.description_en: Queries the information about resource plans of an Alibaba Cloud service
DescribeResourcePackageProduct.description_zh: 查询某个资源包产品的信息

DescribeResourceUsageDetail.description_en: Queries the usage details of reserved instances (RIs) or storage capacity units (SCUs)
DescribeResourceUsageDetail.description_zh: 预留实例、SCU使用率明细查询

DescribeResourceUsageTotal.description_en: Queries the total usage data of reserved instances or storage capacity units (SCUs)
DescribeResourceUsageTotal.description_zh: 预留实例、SCU使用率汇总查询

DescribeSavingsPlansCoverageDetail.description_en: Queries detailed information about savings plan coverage
DescribeSavingsPlansCoverageDetail.description_zh: 节省计划覆盖率明细查询

DescribeSavingsPlansCoverageTotal.description_en: Queries the total coverage of savings plans
DescribeSavingsPlansCoverageTotal.description_zh: 节省计划覆盖率汇总查询

DescribeSavingsPlansUsageDetail.description_en: Queries the usage details of savings plans
DescribeSavingsPlansUsageDetail.description_zh: 节省计划使用率明细查询

DescribeSavingsPlansUsageTotal.description_en: Queries the total usage of savings plans
DescribeSavingsPlansUsageTotal.description_zh: 节省计划使用率汇总查询

GetAccountRelation.description_en: Queries the details of a financial relationship

GetCustomerAccountInfo.description_en: Queries the account information of an end customer under a partner
GetCustomerAccountInfo.description_zh: 查询虚商下终端客户账号信息

GetCustomerList.description_en: Queries the list of end customer UIDs under a partner
GetCustomerList.description_zh: 查询虚商下的终端客户uid列表

GetOrderDetail.description_en: Queries the details of an order that belongs to your Alibaba Cloud account or distributors
GetOrderDetail.description_zh: 查询用户或分销客户某个订单详情信息

GetPayAsYouGoPrice.description_en: Queries the price of a pay-as-you-go product

GetResourcePackagePrice.description_en: Queries the price of a resource plan
GetResourcePackagePrice.description_zh: 查询用户某个资源包的价格

GetSubscriptionPrice.description_en: Queries the price of a subscription product

InquiryPriceRefundInstance.description_en: Queries the refund amount for an instance that you want to unsubscribe from
InquiryPriceRefundInstance.description_zh: InquiryPriceRefundInstance：调用本接口对需要退订的实例进行询价

ModifyAccountRelation.description_en: Adds or deletes permissions for an account linking relationship
ModifyAccountRelation.description_zh: 支持添加、删除财务关联权限点

ModifyCostUnit.description_en: Modifies one or more cost centers
ModifyCostUnit.description_zh: 修改财务单元，支持批量修改

ModifyInstance.description_en: Modifies the resource configuration of an instance. Invoking this operation creates an order for the Upgrade/Downgrade of instance resources and processes automatic payment. This operation does not support configuration changes for ECS or RDS products. Use the dedicated API of the corresponding product to execute the Upgrade/Downgrade
ModifyInstance.description_zh: 对实例资源配置进行变更。调用接口会创建一个变配实例资源的订单，并自动支付。该接口不支持ECS和RDS 系列产品的变更，请查找对应产品的专有API执行变配

QueryAccountBalance.description_zh: 查询用户账户余额信息

QueryAccountBill.description_en: Queries account spending within a billing cycle and aggregates the data by resource owner
QueryAccountBill.description_zh: 查询用户某个账期内的消费，并以资源所有者的维度进行汇总

QueryAccountTransactionDetails.description_en: Queries the details of account transactions (income and expenditure)

QueryAccountTransactions.description_en: Queries transactions within your Alibaba Cloud account
QueryAccountTransactions.description_zh: 查询用户账户流水信息

QueryAvailableInstances.description_zh: 查询用户可用实例列表

QueryBill.description_en: Queries the settlement bills of a user within a specific billing cycle
QueryBill.description_zh: 查询用户某个账期内的结算账单

QueryBillOverview.description_en: Queries the bill overview of a user for a specific billing cycle
QueryBillOverview.description_zh: 查询用户某个账期内的账单总览信息

QueryBillToOSSSubscription.description_en: Queries the subscribed bills that are stored in Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket
QueryBillToOSSSubscription.description_zh: 查询账单订阅到OSS储存桶的记录

QueryCommodityList.description_en: Retrieves a list of commodity information based on a product code
QueryCommodityList.description_zh: 该接口提供根据产品code获取商品信息列表的能力

QueryCostUnit.description_en: Queries all cost centers within the current node of the cost center tree. If the ParentUnitId parameter is set to -1, all cost centers are queried
QueryCostUnit.description_zh: 查询财务单元树当前节点下的所有财务单元节点。当 ParentUnitId 为 -1，表示查所有财务单元

QueryCostUnitResource.description_en: Queries the resource instances that are allocated to a cost center. If the unitId parameter is set to 0, the unallocated primary resource instances and sub-resource instances are queried
QueryCostUnitResource.description_zh: 查询用户的财务单元所属的资源实例列表。当 UnitId 为 0，表示查未分配的主子资源实例

QueryCustomerAddressList.description_en: Queries the mailing addresses for Alibaba Cloud invoices
QueryCustomerAddressList.description_zh: 查询阿里云发票邮寄地址信息服务

QueryDPUtilizationDetail.description_en: Queries the usage of resource plans, including reserved instances (RIs) and storage capacity units (SCUs)
QueryDPUtilizationDetail.description_zh: 查询资源包(包含RI、scu)的使用量情况

QueryEvaluateList.description_en: Queries a list of objects that are eligible for invoicing

QueryFinancialAccountInfo.description_en: Queries the financial information of an enterprise account that is part of a management-member relationship
QueryFinancialAccountInfo.description_zh: 查询有主子关系权限的账号的企业财务账号信息

QueryInstanceBill.description_en: Queries the usage summary of all product instances or billable items for an account in a billing cycle. This operation has been upgraded to DescribeInstanceBill. This operation no longer queries data beyond the 50,000th row
QueryInstanceBill.description_zh: 查询用户某个账期内所有商品实例或计费项的消费汇总。API 已升级为 DescribeInstanceBill，此API不再提供50000行以后数据的查询

QueryInstanceByTag.description_en: Queries a list of instances by tags
QueryInstanceByTag.description_zh: 根据标签信息查询实例列表

QueryInstanceGaapCost.description_en: This API is deprecated. Use the following APIs to retrieve the amortized cost: `DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByAmortizationPeriod` - retrieves instance costs by amortization period; `DescribeProductAmortizedCostByAmortizationPeriod` - retrieves product costs by amortization period; `DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByConsumePeriod` - retrieves instance costs by consume period; `DescribeProductAmortizedCostByConsumePeriod` - retrieves product costs by consume period
QueryInstanceGaapCost.description_zh: 该 API 不再更新。请前往使用如下API获取对应分摊成本：DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByAmortizationPeriod - 查询实例摊销月摊销成本；DescribeProductAmortizedCostByAmortizationPeriod- 查询产品摊销月摊销成本；DescribeInstanceAmortizedCostByConsumePeriod- 查询实例账期月摊销成本；DescribeProductAmortizedCostByConsumePeriod- 查询产品账期月摊销成本

QueryInvoicingCustomerList.description_en: Queries the invoicing information of an Alibaba Cloud user
QueryInvoicingCustomerList.description_zh: 查询阿里云用户发票抬头信息

QueryOrders.description_en: Queries the orders of a user or a distribution customer. By default, the query returns orders created within the last hour. To query orders over a longer period, set the CreateTimeStart and CreateTimeEnd parameters
QueryOrders.description_zh: 查询用户或者分销客户订单列表情况。默认查询当前时间最近1小时范围内订单，如需查询更长时间范围的订单数据，请设CreateTimeStart和CreateTimeEnd参数

QueryPermissionList.description_en: Queries the permissions for a master-member relationship based on the relationship ID
QueryPermissionList.description_zh: 根据关系ID查询有主子关系权限的关系的权限列表

QueryPrepaidCards.description_en: Queries information about a user's prepaid cards

QueryPriceEntityList.description_en: Queries the pricing entities under a commodity. A pricing entity is the smallest product capability used for metering and cost calculation
QueryPriceEntityList.description_zh:
本API是用来查询一个商品下有哪些定价对象。
定价对象是用来计量和计算费用的最小产品能力

QueryProductList.description_en: Queries the list of products available for the current account to order. The response includes the product code, product name, and subscription type (subscription or pay-as-you-go)
QueryProductList.description_zh: 查询当前账号可订购的产品清单，返回产品code、产品名称和订阅模式（预付费/后付费）等信息

QueryRIUtilizationDetail.description_en: Queries the usage details of a reserved instance (RI)

QueryRedeem.description_en: Queries the information about a voucher

QueryRelationList.description_en: Queries a list of the relationships of member accounts
QueryRelationList.description_zh: 查询有主子关系权限的账号的成员账号关系列表

QueryResellerAvailableQuota.description_en: Queries the available quota for a user in a reseller payment scenario
QueryResellerAvailableQuota.description_zh: 查询用户（代付场景下设置消费配额）的当前可用配额余额信息

QueryResellerUserAlarmThreshold.description_en: 查询用户的信控预警阀值,该接口暂未测试启用
QueryResellerUserAlarmThreshold.description_zh: 查询用户的信控预警阀值,该接口暂未测试启用

QueryResourcePackageInstances.description_en: Queries the instances of a resource plan. You can query the resource plans that are valid
QueryResourcePackageInstances.description_zh: 查询用户某个资源包的实例，仅支持查询有效的资源包

QuerySavingsPlansDeductLog.description_en: Queries the details of savings plan deductions
QuerySavingsPlansDeductLog.description_zh: 查询节省计划抵扣的明细数据

QuerySavingsPlansDiscount.description_en: Queries the discount information for savings plans
QuerySavingsPlansDiscount.description_zh: 查询节省计划折扣信息列表

QuerySavingsPlansInstance.description_en: Queries information about your savings plan instances
QuerySavingsPlansInstance.description_zh: 查询当前用户保有的节省计划实例信息

QuerySettleBill.description_en: Queries the settlement bills of a user for a specific billing cycle. Supports domestic accounts with more than 50,000 bill entries
QuerySettleBill.description_zh: 查询用户某个账期内的结算账单。支持账单条目超过50000条的国内账号

QuerySkuPriceList.description_en: Queries the SKU list and list prices under a specified pricing entity of a commodity. A product feature typically has 1 to multiple SKUs, and some products may have tens of thousands of SKUs. The request parameters support filtered queries based on specific SKU configuration conditions
QuerySkuPriceList.description_zh:
通常一个产品功能会有1到多个SKU，有的产品会多达数万级别的SKU。
本API是用来查询一个指定的产品功能下的SKU列表及其目录价。接口入参支持按照某种SKU配置的条件来进行过滤查询

QuerySplitItemBill.description_en: Queries split bills. This API has been upgraded. We recommend that you use the new DescribeSplitItemBill operation
QuerySplitItemBill.description_zh: 查询分账账单。分账账单 API 已升级，请使用新版API：DescribeSplitItemBill

QueryUserOmsData.description_en: Queries the metering records for a specified cloud product
QueryUserOmsData.description_zh: 根据传入的云产品查询相应的计量记录

RefundInstance.description_en: Unsubscribes from an instance that is no longer needed
RefundInstance.description_zh: 调用本接口退订不再需要的实例

ReleaseInstance.description_en: Releases instances by Virtual Network Operators (VNOs)
ReleaseInstance.description_zh: 国家云虚商侧主动释放实例

RelieveAccountRelation.description_en: Disassociates a RAM user from an Alibaba Cloud account

RenewChangeInstance.description_en: Renews an instance and changes its configuration. The configuration change is applied after the renewal order takes effect. Payment is processed automatically. This operation cannot be used to create ECS or RDS instances
RenewChangeInstance.description_zh: 对一个实例续费的同时进行变配操作，实际变配时间，是续费订单生效的时间，并自动支付。不支持ECS和RDS系列产品的创建

RenewInstance.description_en: Renews a specified instance. This operation does not support renewing ECS, RDS, or Redis instances. To renew these instances, call the dedicated renewal API of the corresponding service
RenewInstance.description_zh: 对相关实例进行续费。不支持ECS、RDS、REDIS产品类实例的续费，请查找对应产品的专用续费API执行续费

RenewResourcePackage.description_zh: 为用户某个资源包实例续费

SetAllExpirationDay.description_en: Sets an expiration date for all Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances
SetAllExpirationDay.description_zh: 为ECS实例的续费设置统一到期日

SetRenewal.description_zh: 调用SetRenewal为一个实例设置自动续费服务

SetResellerUserQuota.description_en: Modify the quota ledger and consumption ledger
SetResellerUserQuota.description_zh: 创建用户quota配额账本和quota消费账本

SetResellerUserStatus.description_en: Enables or disables the SQL audit feature for users
SetResellerUserStatus.description_zh: 开启或关闭用户sql审计功能

SubscribeBillToOSS.description_en: Subscribes to bill files and stores the bill data in a specified Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket
SubscribeBillToOSS.description_zh: 使用OSS订阅账单文件，支持将账单数据存储到指定的OSS bucket中

TagResources.description_zh: 支持添加资源上配置的标签

UnsubscribeBillToOSS.description_en: Unsubscribes from the detailed bill export service

UntagResources.description_zh: 取消资源上配置的标签

UpgradeResourcePackage.description_zh: 升级用户某个资源包的实例。如本周期已升级，则无法继续升级，待次周期生效后再操作升级
